title: [Peek] Image previews are not sized to native pixel dimensions on scaled displays
author: daverayment

status.label: Maintainer-owned investigation
status.detail: A Peek collaborator filed, self-assigned, reproduced, and scoped this distinct DPI/native-pixel sizing issue on current main.

next_action.label: Leave with current owner
next_action.reason: Do not start parallel agent work while the self-assigned collaborator is actively investigating the sizing path.

judgment.rationale: The report is implementation-ready for its current collaborator-owner and explicitly distinguishes itself from the related cross-display and minimum-size issues; parallel dashboard design work would duplicate active ownership.
evidence: The issue author daverayment is a repository collaborator and is assigned to the issue.
The body provides measured expected and actual window dimensions at 175% and 125% scaling.
The author explicitly distinguishes #50193 and #50243, and a follow-up notes the title bar is also treated as physical pixels.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve the issue as maintainer-owned and do not expose a duplicate-close or design-approval action.

issue_context.summary: Peek displays a known-size image at inconsistent, non-native physical dimensions across differently scaled monitors; the self-assigned collaborator has isolated several DPI/unit boundaries for investigation.
known_information: A 512×512 image produces documented incorrect outer-window sizes on 175% and 125% displays.
The issue was reproduced on a current-main development build.
The title bar measurement is also affected according to the collaborator follow-up.
The issue is self-assigned to collaborator daverayment.
inferences: The sizing path likely mixes physical pixels and DIPs or uses stale monitor scale information, as proposed by the reporter, but no merged fix confirms a single root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The evidence is sufficient for engineering, but ownership is already explicit and the report intentionally covers a distinct native-pixel sizing contract rather than duplicating #50193 or #50243. The safe dashboard result is to avoid parallel work.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete body, both comments, labels, assignee, and timeline; no fix PR currently references #50244.

Repository inspection found image dimensions in Peek.Common/Extensions/IFileSystemItemExtensions.cs, scaling in Peek.FilePreviewer/Previewers/MediaPreviewer/ImagePreviewer.cs, minimum sizing in Peek.UI/PeekXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs, and DPI helpers in Peek.UI/Extensions.
The live issue has only automated digest cross-references; no maintainer has declared it a duplicate.
